activity_context.topic_title: Integrating Rational Functions with Irreducible Quadratic Factors

feedback.worked_solution:
The quadratic factor ${x}^{2}+1$ is irreducible, so we proceed with the following partial fraction decomposition:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3{x}^{2}-9x+5}{({x}^{2}+1)(x-4)} & =\frac{Ax+B}{{x}^{2}+1}+\frac{C}{x-4}\end{aligned}
$$

To determine the coefficients $A,B,$ and $C,$ we first multiply both sides of the above equation by $({x}^{2}+1)(x-4),$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2}-9x+5 & =(Ax+B)(x-4)+C({x}^{2}+1).\end{aligned}
$$

Solving for the unknown constants using the usual methods, we get $A=2,B=-1,$ and $C=1.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3{x}^{2}-9x+5}{({x}^{2}+1)(x-4)} & =\frac{2x-1}{{x}^{2}+1}+\frac{1}{x-4}\end{aligned}
$$

We now integrate this function term by term, adding the constant of integration at the very end.

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{3{x}^{2}-9x+5}{({x}^{2}+1)(x-4)}\,\text{d}x & =\int (\frac{2x-1}{{x}^{2}+1}+\frac{1}{x-4})\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{2x}{{x}^{2}+1}\,\text{d}x-\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+1}\,\text{d}x+\int \frac{1}{x-4}\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

For the first integral, we use the substitution $u={x}^{2}+3.$ Then $\text{d}u=2x\,\text{d}x,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{2x}{{x}^{2}+1}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{u}\text{d}u \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡|u| \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡|{x}^{2}+1| \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+1).\end{aligned}
$$

For the second integral, we use the fact that $\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+{a}^{2}}\,\text{d}x=\frac{1}{a}\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{a}),$ which results in

$$
\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+1}\,\text{d}x=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x).
$$

Finally, for the third integral, we have

$$
\int \frac{1}{x-4}\,\text{d}x=\operatorname{ln}⁡|x-4|.
$$

So, we get the following result:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{3{x}^{2}-9x+5}{({x}^{2}+1)(x-4)}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{2x}{{x}^{2}+1}\,\text{d}x-\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+1}\,\text{d}x+\int \frac{1}{x-4}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+1)-\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x)+\operatorname{ln}⁡|x-4|+K\end{aligned}
$$
